bounds.domain: One authorized combined-mode API-key request, one asynchronous preflight and dispatch, four outcomes, one cancellation before admission, and one disposal.
bounds.scope: The guard stays live until dispatch settles. Local refusal, failure and cancellation consume one standalone proof; admitted work consumes the admission proof instead. Weak fairness of enabled progress assumes preflight, dispatch and disposal eventually return, without assuming provider success. Without fairness the caller may remain waiting.
bounds.limits: The model abstracts identity, revocation results, billing, provider effects, network retries, multiple requests, and stream consumption after the Response is returned. Existing admission models own durable billing and credential authority. The conformance run uses the real Hono route, guard and proxy engine with controlled caller, provider and billing boundaries; it is not live-provider or production acceptance.

assumptions: Weak fairness of advance assumes each enabled preflight, dispatch completion or disposal eventually runs; provider success is not assumed.
Without fairness, an asynchronous stage may remain pending indefinitely.
